source:
🏉 Rugby Champions

Step onto the field and become a rugby legend! Pass, tackle, kick, score tries, and work with your teammates to win exciting matches.

Features

🏃 Sprint and dodge defenders. 

🤝 Pass the ball to teammates. 

💥 Tackle opponents to stop attacks. 

🥅 Kick conversions and penalty goals. 

🏆 Play 7v7 or 15v15 matches. 

💰 Earn coins after every match. 

🎽 Unlock new jerseys, boots, celebrations, and rugby balls. 

📈 Level up and improve your skills. 

Can you lead your team to victory and become the greatest rugby player?

Tutorial

When a player joins for the first time:

Welcome

Welcome to Rugby Champions! Your goal is to score more points than the other team.

Step 1 - Move

Use WASD to move. Hold Shift to sprint.

Player must walk to the highlighted marker.

Reward:

+50 Coins

Step 2 - Pick Up Ball

Walk over the rugby ball to pick it up.

Player touches the ball.

Step 3 - Pass

Press Q to pass to your teammate.

Player passes successfully.

Step 4 - Tackle

Press E near an opponent to tackle.

A practice dummy runs toward the player.

Step 5 - Score a Try

Run into the in-goal area while holding the ball.

Animation plays.

TRY! +5 Points

Step 6 - Conversion Kick

Aim using your mouse. Hold Left Click to build power. Release to kick.

Tutorial Complete

Congratulations! You are ready for online matches. Good luck!

Reward:

500 Coins 

Rookie Jersey 

Beginner Title 

Game Modes

Quick Match

Join instantly 

7v7 

Ranked

Competitive games 

Earn rank points 

Practice

AI opponents 

Learn controls 

Tournament

Large knockout competitions 

Controls

KeyActionWASDMoveShiftSprintQPassETackleSpaceJumpLeft ClickKickRDiveFCelebrate

Progression

Players earn:

Coins 

XP 

Jerseys 

Boots 

Ball skins 

Celebrations 

Titles 

Match Rules

Try = 5 points 

Conversion = 2 points 

Penalty Goal = 3 points 

Drop Goal = 3 points 

Match length: 10 minutes 

Team with the most points wins. 

Roblox Studio Structure

Workspace ├── RugbyField ├── Goals ├── Ball ├── SpawnLocations StarterPlayer ├── StarterCharacterScripts │ ├── Sprint │ ├── Tackle │ ├── BallPickup ReplicatedStorage ├── Remotes │ ├── PassBall │ ├── TacklePlayer │ ├── KickBall ServerScriptService ├── MatchManager ├── ScoreManager ├── TutorialManager ├── CoinRewards StarterGui ├── MainMenu ├── TutorialUI ├── Scoreboard ├── Shop ├── Settings

This design gives you a solid foundation for a polished Roblox rugby game with clear gameplay, a guided tutorial for new players, multiple game modes, progression, and a description suitable for the Roblox experience page. If you want to build it in Roblox Studio, I can also generate the Lua scripts for systems like ball handling, passing, tackling, scoring, matchmaking, and the tutorial.

answers.ask: Should this be a bare training pitch, a school ground, or a full floodlit professional stadium?
answers.answer: Use a full floodlit professional stadium to match the polished Rugby Champions experience.

answers.ask: Should the pitch be sized for 15v15, or tightened for 7v7?
answers.answer: Tighten the pitch for 7v7 as the primary quick-match format; 15v15 can remain a selectable mode without requiring a larger initial map.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: Should this be a bare training pitch, a school ground, or a full floodlit professional stadium? A: Use a full floodlit professional stadium to match the polished Rugby Champions experience.
- [author] player count — Q: Should the pitch be sized for 15v15, or tightened for 7v7? A: Tighten the pitch for 7v7 as the primary quick-match format; 15v15 can remain a selectable mode without requiring a larger initial map.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a polished floodlit professional rugby stadium centered on one compact pitch tightened for 7-versus-7 play while still supporting an optional 15-versus-15 mode on the same field. Mark a rigid touchline and dead-ball perimeter, halfway line, field-distance lines, two in-goal try areas, and one H-shaped goal at each end. Place two team benches outside opposite sidelines and frame the pitch with tiered spectator seating, an outer stadium wall, and floodlight structures. Keep the playing surface unobstructed for sprinting, passing, tackling, kicking, and diving. Use the same pitch for tutorial and practice actions rather than creating another map, with enough sideline clearance for safe resets and highlighted drill positions.

## Genre
The dominant and only genre is Sports, specifically a team field sport played inside a fixed rugby pitch.

## Shape and preset
Use `space-bounded`, named Zone (Bounded Field or Court): the touchlines, dead-ball lines, and in-goal areas rigidly define play. The matched preset is Field Sport, expanded with the requested full-stadium seating, enclosure, team sectors, and floodlighting.

## Config requirements
Use the visible half of `trigger-bounds` for the complete rugby-field perimeter. Use the visible half of `startpoint-play` for the midfield ball reset and player restart marks. Use the visible half of `trigger-scoring` for two in-goal areas and two goal structures. Use `marker-distance` for halfway and field-progress markings. Add `spectator-bleachers` for tiered stands, `barrier-perimeter` for the outer stadium wall, and `spectator-zone` for two team benches outside the touchlines.

## Layout requirements
Place one `trigger-bounds` detection perimeter around the active pitch. Place 14 player `startpoint-play` positions in two balanced groups of seven plus one ball reset at midfield; the optional 15v15 mode reuses the same field with additional runtime positions. Place four `trigger-scoring` volumes: two in-goal try regions and one kick-detection plane through each of the two H-shaped goals. Place one `spawner-npc` practice-dummy origin behind the tutorial tackle marker. Scoring values, controls, timers, rewards, progression, matchmaking, UI, and scripts are mechanics.

## Layout components
The main zone is one compact rugby pitch with midfield, marked progress lines, touchline boundary, two in-goal areas, and two end goals. Fourteen primary start positions and the ball reset sit inside the field. Two team benches occupy opposite sidelines; tiered stands and a stadium wall surround the pitch; floodlights rise outside play. Tutorial drills reuse field markers and one practice-dummy origin without adding another map. Compose the stadium symmetrically around the pitch so every scoring end and sideline sector is visible.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: lay out the parametric rugby pitch, markings, starts, scoring regions, benches, and containment first, then dress the isometric floodlit stadium. The top-down plan is authoritative because accurate field geometry and balanced team positions matter more than freeform architectural composition.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is medium, driven by one tightened 7v7 field plus professional stands while player positions and field markings remain legible. The theme is a polished floodlit professional rugby stadium. `tiered` is required for the raked spectator seating; otherwise the geometry remains one bounded surface and needs no additional modifier.
